name: Skuad
summary: Skuad employs full-time hires through locally compliant contracts and manages statutory benefits and social contributions. Employer of record starts at $199 per employee per month, with discounts for more onboardings that are not published.

evidence.capability: employment in countries without an entity

facts.text: Skuad's EOR page says 160+ countries while an FAQ on the same page says 150+, so confirm your country before relying on either figure.
Skuad says it runs payroll in 70 currencies and offers 24/5 support.
Skuad's pricing page publishes only the starting price and directs buyers to a demo for the full fee structure.

plans.name: Employer of Record
plans.notes: Starting price. Discounts for more onboardings are mentioned without amounts

hiddenCosts: Billing frequency, deposits and other fees are not published; ask for them in writing.
The $199 is a floor, and the final rate is set through a demo.
